paragraphs.text: The Eternal is a god of monotheistic religion practiced in the land of Kush on Aerona .
He is regarded as an omnipotent and immortal creator, protector, and destroyer.

Followers of the Eternal believe that great powers uphold the five corners of the world. When beginning a meal, they show reverence to these powers by tearing off five pieces of a loaf of bread and tossing them to each corner, followed by five tosses of salt. The dead are given gold coins to pay the ferryman to take them to the afterlife. Legends speak of younger days when there were demigods who struggled for control of Dominaria who later disappeared. This likely referred to planeswalkers.

It is said that on the day of Ragalka, the Eternal will return and destroy the world, keeping those mortals he finds worthy. The Muronian Order devotes itself to reminding the public about the fragility of everything.
In Shattered Chains , multiple characters make references to "the Eternals". It is unclear if these pluralized Eternals refer to the same being as the Eternal.
